rows.prediction: P1: anti-aligned features have structured local neighborhoods, not random isolation
rows.literature: Goodfire neural geometry; Hindupur 2025; Supplement 3 hedge-family mechanism
rows.observations: Neuronpedia depth-1 graph has 113 nodes / 238 thresholded undirected edges. Hedge-family mean degree=10; F19139-F11969 decoder cosine≈0.8423. Parent cluster internal cosines≈0.67-0.94.
rows.inference: Structured neighborhoods exist for queried hedge/parent features.
rows.alternatives: Ordinary decoder feature-family clustering; dead-feature artifacts; Neuronpedia top-k bias.
rows.status: weak support / motivates H7, not diagnostic
rows.next_test: Expand neighbor crawl and compare against random anti-aligned and aligned controls.

rows.prediction: P2: local PCA around hedge-parent clusters has intrinsic dimension > 1
rows.observations: No actual W_dec/W_enc vectors loaded in this continuation. Neuronpedia graph alone cannot estimate PCA dimension.
rows.alternatives: Rank-1 local feature families; simple parent-child hedges without manifold.
rows.next_test: Load public Bloom GPT-2 L8 SAE vectors and run local PCA / participation ratio on top-k neighborhoods.

rows.prediction: P3: geodesic graph distance differs from direct chord/cosine distance in curved neighborhoods
rows.literature: Goodfire manifold steering; representation manifolds; graph manifold learning
rows.observations: Depth-1 graph built from topkCosSim is available, but direct pairwise cosines are sparse and graph is query-biased. Several seed groups fall into separate components; largest component includes F19139/F11969/F20804, F10666, F22561.
rows.inference: Graph-proxy test is feasible but currently underpowered.
rows.alternatives: Top-k graph construction artifact; component structure from query seed choice rather than manifold.
rows.next_test: Crawl neighbor graph to depth 2 with cap; compute geodesic/chord ratios only where direct cosine is available or vectors are loaded.

rows.prediction: P4: active anti-aligned features sit in dense neighborhoods or transition regions

rows.observations: Random layer-8 features [labelled 'active anti-aligned' in the original run; see ERRATA E7] F22561, F6165, F5977, F3696 each have degree≈10 in depth-1 graph. They belong to components of size 50 or 11, but semantic explanations are diverse.

rows.alternatives: Any queried Neuronpedia feature has 10 top neighbors by construction; degree alone is weak.

rows.next_test: Compare component sizes/clustering to matched active aligned features and random L8 features.

rows.prediction: P5: F1803 behaves like a coordinate/shard of temporal manifold rather than isolated scalar feature
rows.literature: Engels 2024 multidimensional features; Goodfire neural geometry; Wurgaft 2026 steering
rows.observations: COS3 cached JSON exists. PCA variance: PC1=0.3054, PC2=0.2663, PC3=0.2374, PC4=0.1908; PC2/PC1=0.872. ANOM_2023 JSON exists and supports tokenization confound.
rows.inference: F1803 temporal data are compatible with a multidimensional temporal manifold reading.
rows.alternatives: PCA over chosen prompts may reflect prompt-template/tokenization variation; F1803 may still be a specificity gate with surrounding confounds, not a manifold shard.
rows.status: moderate support for temporal-manifold framing; not direct support for anti-aligned H7
rows.next_test: Parse COS3 per-prompt coordinates, test year trajectory geometry, separate tokenization/template axes, and compare with F1803 decoder-neighbor graph.

rows.prediction: P6: manifold-aware steering is cleaner than linear single-feature steering
rows.observations: Prior report says PC1 steering increased logit_diff by ≈+0.43, but no side-by-side linear-vs-manifold steering benchmark exists here.
rows.inference: Causal relevance of temporal PC1 is suggestive only.
rows.alternatives: PC1 may be ordinary linear direction; steering metric may not test off-manifold naturalness.
rows.next_test: Define behavior-space metric and compare F1803 decoder steering, PC1 steering, and geodesic/tangent steering.
